mapper.sql: o.id, o.application_id, o.student_id, o.objector_id, o.objector_name, o.content, o.evidence, o.status, o.answer, o.answered_by, o.deadline, o.answered_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.deleted, a.cert_year AS cert_year, a.poverty_level AS poverty_level
FROM aid_objection o LEFT JOIN aid_application a ON a.id = o.application_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = o.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aid_objection (application_id, student_id, objector_id, objector_name, content, evidence, status, deadline, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{studentId}, #{objectorId}, #{objectorName}, #{content}, #{evidence}, #{status}, #{deadline}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE o.student_id = #{studentId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT
WHERE o.application_id = #{applicationId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_objection WHERE deleted = 0 AND application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_objection SET answer = #{answer}, status = #{status}, answered_by = #{answeredBy}, answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending'
